purpose: Increase XuanTie-E902 nstates and repeated steps after the conservative CPU exact-loop baseline showed CPU-favorable throughput.
preconditions: XuanTie-E902 GPU cubin and meta are present under artifacts/xuantie_e902_obj_dir
artifacts/ and reports/ are ignored generated outputs

correctness_policy.baseline: one-state normalized CPU/GPU final-state equivalence plus conservative repeated-step CPU/GPU timing surface
batched_gpu_runs: dumped state byte size equals storage_size * nstates when dump is requested
no large-workload CPU/GPU speedup claim is made until a matching CPU exact-loop baseline exists

non_claims: no XuanTie speedup claim until a matching large-workload CPU exact-loop baseline exists
no full non-TL-UL generality claim from one E902 wrapper
this gate is a GPU crossover search gate, not a release boundary
